profile.capacity_policy: preserve original five-seed calibration; only strong/weak levels used
profile.iteration_policy: latest user-confirmed repacking counts; no multiplication by nine
profile.submission_policy: full only; selected RCL/kick inherited from source

conventions.kick_trigger: ceil(n/2) consecutive rejected LS repacking calls; reset on improvement
conventions.hybrid_budget: n LS repacking calls per construction; never reset on improvement
conventions.rcl_pool: up to 160 orientation-position pairs in current bin; bottom/top extrema
conventions.objective: N-U_star; U_star excludes the least-filled bin by volume
conventions.parameter_selection: inherit globally selected RCL and kick from source experiments
conventions.deadline: includes construction, LS and kicks; finish one in-flight call before stopping
